description: Start upscaling a video to 1080p, 2k or 4k. Charges credits for the whole video (its length is read from the file) and returns the task. Downloading a large video can take a few minutes. If this call times out or fails, first call list_tasks to see whether the task was created, and retry only with the SAME idempotency_key: a new key charges again.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this request, e.g. a UUID (printable ASCII, no spaces). Reuse it when retrying the same request.

video_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the video (MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 500MB; up to 1200 seconds at 1080p, 600 seconds at 2k and 4k), or the video_url returned by create_upload

name: upscale_video
title: Upscale a video
